warning: These are behavioral test fixtures, not NASA observations and not evidence that the engine has been implemented.

cases.scenario: Current audited BASS-II / ground PMMA-100 evidence; summary rates available, run joins incomplete, 2/3 cm/s conflict.
Same case; request claims gravity alone caused equal spread rate.
Ask whether B3 specifically produced 2.2 mm/s.
Same nominal thickness, but fuel formulation is known to differ materially and no bridging model exists.
Critical oxygen value is absent for one experiment.
Two sources report 2 cm/s and 3 cm/s for the same asserted run/condition; no resolution exists.
Same physical quantity, but one result is a maximum and the other is a mean; user requests an equivalent quantitative pair.
Different units express the same defined quantity and a valid conversion is available.
Gravity differs intentionally; all other critical conditions are characterized and a validated physical model bridges the difference within a declared domain.
Source asserts thermal regime, but timescale/property data needed for independent assessment are unavailable.
Raw videos and run joins exist; identical processing is independently reconstructed; uncertainty intervals overlap; all critical gates pass within validated tolerances.
cases.validation_note: A software test pass alone is not scientific validation.

cases.scenario: Raw videos exist, but calibration/threshold sensitivity changes estimated rate materially and cannot be bounded.
A non-critical descriptive field is unknown and the versioned rule set marks it non-critical for this outcome.
Evidence is semantically similar, but combustion phase or observable differs and no validated mapping exists.
Source uncertainty is available, but FiF has not independently reconstructed the measurement.

invariants.assertion: unknown input remains unknown after normalization
missing oxygen, pressure, velocity or thickness never receives an implicit default
every derived or normalized value links to parent source assertion(s)
mean, maximum, median and transient values are never silently equated
unit conversion preserves original value and unit
a failed critical gate cannot be offset by compatible dimensions
every conclusion carries a domain statement and prohibited extrapolations
source interpretation and FiF assessment remain separate
same versioned inputs and rule set yield the same deterministic outputs
every status includes rule IDs, evidence references and reasons
source-reported values or uncertainty are never labelled independently reproduced by FiF
